steps.name: place-pool-table
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const rooms=(st.floorPlan.rooms||[]); const room=rooms.find(r=>!r.external)||rooms[0]; st.enterRoomEditor(room.id); const ox=room.origin?room.origin[0]:0, oz=room.origin?room.origin[1]:0; const cx=ox+(room.width||3)/2, cz=oz+(room.depth||3)/2; const id='verify-pool'; const it={ id, defId:'pool-table-6ft', position:[cx,cz], rotation:0, props:{} }; const s2=window.__store.getState(); s2.setItems([...s2.items.filter(i=>i.id!==id), it]); s2.selectItem(id); return id; })()

steps.name: recolour-part
steps.eval: (() => { const hdr=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(d=>d.textContent.trim()==='Recolour parts'); const sec=hdr&&hdr.parentElement; const inp=sec&&sec.querySelector('input[type=color]'); if(!inp) return 'no-picker'; const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(inp,'#ff2d2d'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'set'; })()
